zombies.title: Dead processes are piling up
zombies.why: Programs exited but nothing cleaned them up. Harmless in small numbers; a leak if the count keeps rising.

sustained-load.title: The server has been running hot
sustained-load.why: Load stayed above the number of CPUs for several minutes, so everything on it slows down.

sustained-burner.title: A program has been hogging the CPU
sustained-burner.why: One process has used most of a CPU for most of its life, often a stuck loop or a leaked browser.

container-pegged.title: A container is maxing out its CPU
container-pegged.short: a container maxing out its CPU
container-pegged.why: A Docker container has been at full CPU for a while.

unit-failed.title: A service failed
unit-failed.why: A background service stopped and nothing will restart it on its own.

restart-storm.title: A service keeps restarting
restart-storm.why: It crashes and is restarted over and over, which burns CPU and hides the real error.

variants.how: Usually clears by itself. Ask DAEDALUS to look (box_health) if it keeps coming back.
